Progress report (bd-3aen, BeigeFern):

ENGINE PASS (LOOP_EXTRA=--engine, gate fw-gate-4806): PASS=5 FAIL=2
- S1 baseline drain: PASS (6/6 closed, loop complete)
- S2 crash-resume+dedup: PASS (resumed SAME engine-loop invocation, 4/4 closed exactly once)
- S3 context respawn: PASS (fresh state file -> 1 respawn; stale -> none)
- S4 blocked alert: FAIL (herdr build can't produce blocked via __send - documented limitation, expected identical on legacy)
- S5 frozen escalation: FAIL (loop start blocked by stale pid 10391 - see below)
- S6 unknown repair: PASS (documented limitation pass)

IMPLEMENTED (durable.rs engine_loop, parity port):
- work-mode bead sourcing (poll_inprogress/reclaim_stranded/poll_ready + assigned set)
- completion guard (queue empty + settled + !any_work + !inprogress_blocking -> complete)
- context guard (read_output -> Exhausted -> respawn_and_requeue context_limit)
- send escalation (handle_send_result -> FailStop at 4 -> failstop_message)
- self-heal (pane.exited -> diagnose -> respawn budgeted -> blocked)
- blocked notify (notify_blocked leaf for --on-blocked mail)
- registered 8 more leaves in run_engine_loop

SCRIPT FIXES (e2e-hardened-loop.sh):
1. PROMISE_PREFIX mode-aware (loop-dispatch: for engine, swarm-loop: for legacy) - scenario 5 watcher
2. stale grep '3 prompts' -> '4 prompts' (code changed in 2975851)
3. BROKEN pkill pattern: '\(run \)\?' is BRE but pgrep uses ERE - NEVER matched. Scenario 3's loop survived, single-instance guard blocked scenario 5's fresh loop. Fixed to 'flywheel loop run $PROJ' at all 5 sites.

RE-RUN needed for S5 validation after pkill fix. Also: concurrent unclaimed gate runs (fw-gate-8942/18590/30303 from other sessions) were killed to stop contention.

BINARY NOTE: ~/.local/bin/flywheel was getting SIGKILL'd at exec - root cause: another agent re-copying the 117MB binary in-place while the orchestrator loop (pid 61620) had it mapped; exec of a mid-write Mach-O -> SIGKILL. Fixed with atomic install. Heads up: build+install uses cp (in-place) - other agents should use temp+rename.
